The [[White Crab]] is a [[charmable animal]] found in the [[Tarnished Coast]] and in the [[Depths of Tyria]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Depths of Tyria]]
***{{NPC location|Darkrime Delves}}
***{{NPC location|Frostmaw's Burrows}} (level 3)
***{{NPC location|Raven's Point}} (level 2)
**[[Tarnished Coast]]
***{{NPC location|Arbor Bay}} (in the river, southwest of an island with a [[resurrection shrine]])

==Notes==
*Unlike the [[Lurker]] and [[Reef Lurker]], the White Crab's shell is flat.
*Hearty, Playful, Elder, Aggressive, and unevolved White Crabs deal [[piercing damage]], while Dire White Crabs deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''
